d: Trina puts it all on the line at Verzuz. Amara drops a bomb on Mami Ana. Princess serves at Miami Swim Week. New revelations derail Florence's high-stakes studio session. Ace and Shelah join the Norwoods on a couples date.

Tensions reach a boiling point between Tommie and Spice, Sierra and Keely talk about their feud, BK Brasco gets a surprise, and Tokyo gets pushed to the limit.
